bullets: Operate a fleet of NixOS hosts declared as one flake, with inventory-driven builds and per-host deploy gates.
Wrote Go services for device inventory and health, shipping as static binaries to constrained hardware.
Replaced hand-built release steps with a reproducible pipeline, cutting deploy time from hours to minutes.
Built telemetry collection on Prometheus and alert routing, so a failing host pages before a user notices.
Ran Kubernetes workloads for internal tooling, including ingress, sealed secrets and rolling upgrades.
Maintained a Flask publishing service on MySQL, including schema migrations and markdown rendering.
Automated environment provisioning, removing a manual checklist from every new deployment.
Introduced integration tests around the deploy path after repeated silent failures.
